title: Project Development & Documentation History
introduction: This document provides a chronological overview of major development phases, focusing particularly on documentation efforts.

events.event: Initial project setup with Laravel, Vue 3, Inertia.
Implementation of global event managers (hub.notifyManager, hub.notifyManager, etc.).
Development of initial modules (e.g., Primary Form, Landing Page).

phases.goal: Structure chaotic documentation, eliminate duplication, introduce standards.

events: Corrected initial inaccuracies (e.g., `$path` function removal).
Established new top-level directory structure (`architecture`, `core`, `ui`, `storage`, `testing`, `checklists`, `standards`, `processes`, `prj-mgmt`).
Moved existing documentation into the new structure.
Created main `docs/README.md` and `docs/standards/style-guide.md`.
Created placeholder `README.md` files for new sections.
Introduced Markdown formatting rules (`md.mdc` - details likely in `style-guide.md`).

stages.stageTitle: Stage 2: Manager Documentation & Event System Refactor
events: Documented migration of `NotifyManager` functionality into `NotifyManager`.
Updated all documentation references from `NotifyManager` to `NotifyManager`.
Created comprehensive plan for manager documentation verification.
Verified and updated `NotifyManager` documentation.
Verified and updated `FormManager` documentation to match implementation.
Identified inconsistencies for `ApiManager` and `ValidationManager` (noted as potentially empty).

stages.stageTitle: Stage 3: Verification Methodology & Core Docs Update
stages.dateApprox: Approx. 06-07 April 2023 in logs, integrated here
events: Developed detailed methodology for documentation verification against source code.
Created checklist templates for verifying different component types.
Established templates for verification reports and status updates.
Created initial `verification.md` files in key directories (`core`, `storage`, specific subdirs like `AiRudeDepot`, `modificators`, `Http`).
Added links to verification files in relevant `README.md` files.
Began systematic verification:
**Core (`core/`)**: Updated `Http/README.md`, created `AiRudeDepot/README.md`, `modificators/README.md`. Progress noted on `StepResponse`. Started audit.
**Storage (`storage-v1/`)**: Started audit. Progress noted on `StorageDataModules` (File, Session, Buffer, Model, Directory, Mysql - reaching 100% completion by 15 July 2023 in logs).

stages.dateApprox: Approx. 07 April 2023 in logs, integrated here
events: Created central checklist directory (`docs/checklists/`).
Developed various checklists (`module-verification`, `component-standards`, `process-adherence`, `verifications/*`).
Added task CS012 (Check internal links) to reorganization plan.
Integrated links to checklists into V1 and V2 module documentation (`Landing Page`, `Primary Form`, `Login Form`).
Added warnings/notes about following checklists during development.
Added task CS013 (Verify core docs & link checklists) to reorganization plan.

stages.dateApprox: Approx. 07-08 April 2023 in logs, integrated here
events: Addressed terminology inconsistencies (e.g., 'performance' -> 'efficiency', 'cache' -> 'persistence'), updated relevant files.
Added terminology guide to `docs/standards/style-guide.md`.
Added task CS011 (Eliminate duplicates) to reorganization plan.
Expanded process documentation (`docs/processes/`) with workflows for duplicate removal and link auditing.
Fixed broken links identified (e.g., in Landing Page docs).
Corrected confusion between Core `Hub` component (Path class) and UI `HubManager`.
Reviewed and reorganized `docs/checklists/` content, splitting files into `standards`, `processes`, `checklists/verifications`, `checklists/operational`.
Cleaned up top-level `docs/` files (`STYLE_GUIDE.md` -> `standards/`, `REORGANIZATION_PLAN.md` -> `prj-mgmt/`, `DOCUMENTATION_LINKING_SYSTEM.md` -> `standards/`, deleted `index.md`).
Created `docs/prj-mgmt/improvement-tracker.md`.
Consolidating historical context from `docs_dev/AXILITARY/` into structured project documentation.
Defining next steps based on `improvement-tracker.md` and project priorities.

notes: (Note: Dates extracted from logs are approximate and might reflect logging time rather than exact completion time. They are included for context.)
